description: This source file defines a static utility class 'DbConnectionFactory' that manages caching and creation of database connections, supporting multiple database providers via reflection and assembly loading.

classes.name: DbConnectionFactory.CachedFactory
classes.description: A helper class that encapsulates a cached database provider factory and related metadata.

methods.name: GetFactory
methods.description: Retrieves and caches a DbProviderFactory instance for a given invariant name, loading assemblies and types via reflection.

methods.name: CreateConnection
methods.description: Creates and returns a new DbConnection for the specified provider invariant name and connection string.
